name: zmath_vec3_delta_length_sq
description: zMath::Vec3DeltaLengthSq stores a-b in the shared zMath delta scratch vector and returns the squared length of that delta.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the zMath source-cluster pass.
Binary Ninja currently renders the x87 float return and a stale stack-parameter slot imperfectly; assembly confirms the __fastcall ECX/EDX inputs and st0 float return.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x472670 validates reading the two zVec3 pointers from ECX and EDX, computing a-b for x/y/z, storing the delta into g_zMath_Vec3DeltaScratch, squaring all three scratch components, adding the squared components, and returning the float result in st0.
The native zMath vector smoke verifies a nontrivial delta, the exact scratch vector components, and the squared-length result.
